content: Reyansh Tiwari contacted insurance agent Ravi Menon to inquire about the exact refund amount and deposit timeline for his cancelled auto policy. Ravi confirmed a prorated refund of $480.00 will be credited to his Visa within 7-10 business days (by 05/10/2026), confirmed there are no pending balances, and stated an email confirmation will be sent once processed.
